_preregistration.primary: rho(T_cross, rep_4) against T*'s 0.547 on the same target (F112)
_preregistration.second: rho(slope at crossing, rep_4) -- exploratory, no analogue in T*
_preregistration.censoring: a model whose lambda does not change sign has NO T_cross and is EXCLUDED, not imputed (F87's distinction). A temperature where damage never ignites is MISSING DATA at that temperature (F42: lambda is undefined), not evidence about the model -- the cell is dropped and the model kept, with the count recorded
_preregistration.grid_extension: the first pass used [0.3..1.1] and censored 7 of 10 models, with every crossing found sitting in the 0.3-0.5 interval against the lower edge. 0.1 and 0.2 were added so crossings fall inside the scan rather than on its boundary -- F59's defect on a different axis
_preregistration.coincidence: rho(T_cross, T*) on the subset with both, as the check against measuring one thing twice
_preregistration.boundary: greedy-scoped target, one radius, one lattice size

leverage.reason: T_cross across models spans 0.1662 against its own noise floor 0.07041 (2.36x, gate 2.0x)

verdict: CENSORING: 8 of 14 models never change sign on [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1] and have no T_cross -- [('gpt2', 0.1285, 0.2501), ('gpt2-medium', 0.1144, 0.234), ('gpt2-large', 0.1232, 0.1995), ('facebook/opt-350m', 0.1048, 0.2504), ('bigscience/bloom-560m', 0.1626, 0.3291), ('state-spaces/mamba-130m-hf', 0.1549, 0.2511), ('RWKV/rwkv-4-169m-pile', 0.1156, 0.2832), ('Salesforce/codegen-350M-mono', 0.1392, 0.1945)]. Reported and EXCLUDED, not imputed. PRIMARY: rho(T_cross, rep_4) = +0.486 (permutation p = 0.3556, n = 6), against T*'s +0.547 on the same target. T_cross across models spans 0.1662 against its own noise floor 0.07041 (2.36x, gate 2.0x) SECOND (exploratory): rho(slope at crossing, rep_4) = +0.771 (p = 0.1028). COINCIDENCE CHECK: rho(T_cross, T*) = +0.300 (p = 0.6833, n = 5). They do not track closely, so T_cross is a differently-derived scalar rather than T* in other clothes. READING: if T_cross predicts rep_4 comparably to T*, lambda_ca acquires an external use by the same move that made T* work -- a response rather than a level. If it does not, the structural lesson is confirmed on a second quantity and the one-token response family does not transfer at all. BOUNDARY: greedy-scoped target, one radius, one lattice size.

_note: Applies F112's structural lesson to lambda_ca: not lambda at a temperature but the temperature at which it crosses zero. Tests whether a derived response predicts greedy degeneration as T* does, where the level does not.
